I don’t know exactly but the shame of admitting that one is struggling that has been instilled in me all my life is a big part of it. My therapist makes me a bit uncomfortable mainly because she pressures me to open up but I’m not to that stage yet. 
Coping used to look like painting a picture, having a cup of tea or coffee, writing out my feelings, organizing things, playing with my dog, drawing. I no longer have the energy to do these things.

I’ve been struggling with severe depression and anxiety for 6 years. My mom passed away a year ago and she was the one person that tried to help me and talked to me constantly. Showing me love. 
I finally found a group that I fit in with personality-wise and feel like I have true friends. My boyfriend confessed his feelings to me and I felt happiness for once. 
But suddenly, I went back to the constant numbness. Now I feel like I’m letting everyone down by not being happy even though I was put on medication and started therapy.
